d:
It’s exam result day for Tapu Sena. While Bhide worries over bad omens in his horoscope and canceled tuitions, Anjali Mehta prepares a feast of pav bhaji, biryani, pasta, and gulab jamun to celebrate the kids' expected success—much to Taarak's dismay, as his diet restricts him from eating any of it.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
